# Reptar

> Reptar is a C# web framework targeting Native AOT and Cloudflare Workers (NetWasm), with source-generated JSON, typed RPC codegen, and built-in auth, realtime rooms, and AI agent tooling.

Routes and response metadata generate a typed TypeScript client. Target and provider guarantees differ: the verified SQLite interactive-transaction workload is not a drop-in D1 implementation, and reflection-dependent runtime fallbacks are not blanket AOT guarantees. Consult the documentation and verified examples before choosing a deployment target.

## Documentation

- [Full documentation](https://reptar-docs.rocktownlabs.app/): guides, core concepts, data layer, auth, Cloudflare bindings, cookbook.
- [Docs index for LLMs (llms.txt)](https://reptar-docs.rocktownlabs.app/llms.txt): every page also served as Markdown — append `.md` to any docs URL or request it with `Accept: text/markdown`.
- [Blog API Reference (generated from the OpenAPI contract)](https://reptar-docs.rocktownlabs.app/api/reference/)
- [Verified release benchmarks](https://reptar-bench.rocktownlabs.app): measurements, comparison controls, source revisions, and limitations.

## Project

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/cgRGM/reptar): framework, examples, benchmarks (RealWorld spec, head-to-head vs .NET Minimal API and Hono).
- [Installable agent skill for @reptar/client](https://github.com/cgRGM/reptar/blob/master/packages/rpc/skills/reptar/SKILL.md): routes, TableDef schemas, ColumnRef queries, migrations, and RPC codegen.
- [Quick start](https://reptar-docs.rocktownlabs.app/getting-started/quickstart/): setup, authentication, and deployment instructions.
